name: Strength Journeys
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24 && nvm alias default 24 && export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version default)/bin:$PATH" && node -v && npm ci

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version default)/bin:$PATH" && npm run dev
